verdict.rationale: A national company registry could plausibly publish a developer API with an interactive reference, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains only two probes that returned HTTP 403 at robots.txt on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, with nothing fetched beyond that. There is no evidence of any API reference, let alone an interactive one with runnable examples. Confidence is low because the wall blocked inspection rather than confirming the capability is absent.
